name: Anomaly
description: Information about an anomaly type found on an image by an image segmentation model. For more information, see DetectAnomalies.

allOf.description: The name of an anomaly type found in an image. Name maps to an anomaly type in the training dataset, apart from the anomaly type background. The service automatically inserts the background anomaly type into the response from DetectAnomalies.
Information about the pixel mask that covers an anomaly type.
